_readme: Hand-maintained fixes on top of the generated regions.json, for what the game's drop tables get wrong.
Pets are English names as shown in the app. Areas are region names (e.g. Uruthumheim) or whole maps (e.g. Eltnen).
notFarmable: pets removed from every area (shop pets, event pets).
remove: pets that don't spawn in an area, per area.
add: pets that do spawn in an area but are missing, per area.
